description.fun: A fossil put back together from two that don't belong: a Fossilized Bird on top and a Fossilized Drake below. The powerful tail makes its electricity, while its upper half is far too small. Unbeatable in its time, it still went extinct after eating up all its plant food, or so its Pokédex claims.
description.guide: An Electric and Dragon-type Fossil Pokémon from Pokémon Sword and Shield, restored from the Fossilized Bird and the Fossilized Drake. It was designed by Hitoshi Ariga, like the other three Galar fossils.
description.tagline: A mismatched fossil: tiny bird top, mighty dinosaur bottom
